Orientation day on campus.


the orientation lasted for 3 days. there were many fun activities and informative events. on day one we got to know about our faculity and also played a bingo game which allowed studends to interact with each other. next day we have some activities and got to meet few of the cohorts alumni’s who shared their insights with us. the last day was focused on dinner party where we served many delicious dishes. although we felt little sad that this period was over, but it gave us a huge confidence for the future

title: About
text:
Hi, I’m Yuvraj Singh Walia!
I am from India, where I completed my Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering. I have always been fascinated by data and the way it can be used to uncover insights, solve problems, and support better decision-making. This interest is what motivated me to pursue the Master of Data Science (MDS) program at the University of British Columbia (UBC).
Before starting my MDS journey, I worked as a Quality Analyst as part of a product team. This experience gave me the opportunity to work closely with software products, testing, problem-solving, and different stages of the development process. It also strengthened my interest in working with data and technology to understand problems and build meaningful solutions.
I am excited to continue developing my skills in Data Science, analytics, and machine learning throughout my time at UBC. I look forward to learning from new challenges, collaborating with others, and exploring where this journey in Data Science takes me.
Outside of Data Science, I enjoy exploring my creative side through music and poetry. I love listening to music and occasionally writing my own songs and poems whenever inspiration strikes. I also enjoy meeting new people, having meaningful conversations, and learning from different perspectives and experiences. I like trying new things, exploring new places, and making the most of new experiences. As I begin this new chapter at UBC, I’m looking forward to building new connections, discovering new interests, and creating memorable experiences along the way.
